subject: product.records

recordTypes.summary: An external selection record that binds the governed feature workflow definition.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable feature workflow policy title.

content.summary: The exact governed rules live in the selected Product Context definition artifact.

recordTypes.summary: A product capability or change tracked through an explicit lifecycle with its why kept distinct from its definition.

fields.summary: The concise feature name, distinct from the value or problem statement.
The feature why: the value created or problem removed, without appended definition text.
The explicit portable feature lifecycle state.
The exact current feature, enhancement, bug, or content classification when the configured board supports it.
An optional exact current product-area classification owned by the configured board.
An optional exact current priority classification owned by the configured board.

content.summary: The feature definition lives in a deterministic markdown body whose sections remain separate from Description.

limitations: Board containment identifies the owning product, but the portable model does not infer a board from a display name or discover embedded provider collections.
Current provider options and board-specific templates must be observed through configured capabilities; this model does not invent Area, Priority, Type, or lifecycle values.
A prepared feature body or record change grants no approval, execution, provider-write, lifecycle-transition, or verification authority.
